name: Pazinaclone
summary: Pazinaclone (DN-2327) is a sedative and anxiolytic drug in the cyclopyrrolone family of drugs. Some other cyclopyrrolone drugs include zopiclone and eszopiclone.

pharmacology.text: Pazinaclone produces its sedative and anxiolytic effects by acting as a partial agonist at GABAA benzodiazepine receptors, although pazinaclone is more subtype-selective than most benzodiazepines.

summaryZh: 帕秦克隆（英語：Pazinaclone，開發代號：DN-2327）是環吡咯酮類藥物中的一種鎮靜劑和抗焦慮藥。其他環吡咯酮藥物包括佐匹克隆和右佐匹克隆。
summaryZhHans: 帕秦克隆（英语：Pazinaclone，开发代号：DN-2327）是环吡咯酮类药物中的一种镇静剂和抗焦虑药。其他环吡咯酮药物包括佐匹克隆和右佐匹克隆。

uses.en: It was investigated as a sedative and anti-anxiety medicine and was not brought to market.
uses.zh: 它曾被研究作為鎮靜與抗焦慮藥物，最終未上市。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被研究作为镇静与抗焦虑药物，最终未上市。

sideEffects.en: It acts at the benzodiazepine site of the GABA-A receptor as a partial agonist. Drugs acting there cause drowsiness and poor coordination, and regular use can lead to dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 它以部分促效劑的形式作用於 GABA-A 受體的苯二氮平位點。作用於該位點的藥物會造成嗜睡與協調變差，規律使用可能導致依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它以部分促效剂的形式作用于 GABA-A 受体的苯二氮平位点。作用于该位点的药物会造成嗜睡与协调制差，规律使用可能导致依赖。

fact.en: It is a cyclopyrrolone, the family of zopiclone, and was developed in Japan. Only one of its mirror-image forms does the work.
fact.zh: 它屬於環吡咯酮類，與佐匹克隆同一家族，在日本研發。它的兩種鏡像異構物中只有一種具作用。
fact.zhHans: 它属于环吡咯酮类，与佐匹克隆同一家族，在日本研发。它的两种镜像异构物中只有一种具作用。
